header.running_head: The Incident of a Woman and the Decision of Hadhrat Umar (RA)

blocks.text:
"The night is long and its ends have become dark
I am unable to sleep because I have no beloved to fondle"

Hadhrat Umar (RA) then asked his daughter Hadhrat Hafsa (RA), "What is the maximum period that a woman can do without her husband?" She replied, "Four to six months." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then said, "I shall then not keep an army (away from home) for more than this period."[^1]
The Keenness of the Sahabah (RA) to Encounter Dust in the Path of Allaah
Rasulullaah ﷺ Rebukes those who Disliked experiencing Dust While out in the Path of Allaah

Hadhrat Rabee bin Zaid (RA) narrates that while Rasulullaah ﷺ was once in the centre of the road, he noticed a youngster from the Quraysh walking off the road. When Rasulullaah ﷺ took the youngster's name and asked whether it was he, the Sahabah (RA) confirmed that it was. Rasulullaah ﷺ then asked the Sahabah (RA) to call for him. When he arrived, Rasulullaah ﷺ asked him, "Why are you walking off the road?" "I dislike the dust," he replied. Rasulullaah ﷺ then said, "Do not walk off the road because I swear by the Being Who controls my life that this dust is a special fragrance from Jannah."[^2]
The Incident of Hadhrat Jaabir Bin Abdullaah (RA) in this Regard

Hadhrat Abul Musabbih Muqra'ee narrates that they were once travelling in the Roman territories as a group under the command of Hadhrat Maalik bin Abdullaah Khath'ami (RA). Hadhrat Maalik (RA) passed by Hadhrat Jaabir bin Abdullaah (RA) who was leading his mule along. Hadhrat Maalik (RA) said to Hadhrat Jaabir (RA), "O Abu Abdullaah! Ride because Allaah has provided you with a conveyance." Hadhrat Jaabir (RA) replied, "I have kept my animal in a good condition and require nothing from my people. However, (I am walking because) I have heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say that Allaah has forbidden Jahannam for the person whose feet become dusty in the path of Allaah." Hadhrat Maalik (RA) then proceeded further until he was just within earshot of Hadhrat Jaabir (RA), he then shouted at the top of his voice, "O Abu Abdullaah! Ride because Allaah has provided you with a conveyance." Hadhrat Jaabir (RA) understood what Hadhrat Maalik (RA) wanted (that everyone should hear his reply) so he called out, "I have kept my animal in a good condition and require nothing from my people. However, (I am walking because) I have heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say that Allaah has forbidden Jahannam for the person whose feet become dusty in the path of Allaah."
